title: Kib's Better Vanilla
description: Some tweaks to Minecraft's textures that I like.
body:
**Warning!** 

_This is my first Modrinth project! So be wary of bugs!_ 

This is a work-in-progress resource pack where I have customized most things to _my_ preferences. Most things are quite minor, like slightly changing the stick color, but some are more major, like the inventory texture.

You are allowed to edit my resource pack and change things. If you are posting the pack, then credit me! :)
